name: qlrisk_stress_test
title: Stress testing
description: Stress a book. mode='library' revalues it under qlrisk's historical crisis scenarios (1987_black_monday, 1998_ltcm_russia, 2008_gfc_lehman, 2010_euro_crisis, 2013_taper_tantrum, 2016_brexit, 2020_covid, 2022_rates_shock, 2023_regional_banks) or a chosen subset; mode='custom' under your scenarios, each a list of shocks (factor or curve twist / butterfly / parallel) or a stylised definition (equity, vol, rates, credit, fx_usd, commodity moves); mode='reverse' finds the most plausible market move (minimum Mahalanobis distance) that loses target_loss. Returns P&L per scenario and per trade, worst first. Example: {"trades": [...], "mode": "custom", "custom_scenarios": [{"name": "rates +100bp", "shocks": [{"risk_classes": ["IR"], "shape": "parallel", "size": 0.01}]}]}.
